limitations.statement: Current model focuses on transcriptomic data only, not including genomic or epigenomic data.
Unsupervised pretraining does not leverage rich metadata information.
Pretraining data may not fully reflect the complexity of human organ development and health states.
Batch effects or modality differences are left to cooperative downstream methods.
Users are recommended to use cell and gene embeddings rather than predicted gene expression values due to high dropout rates in labels.

methods.description: Scalable transformer-based model with embedding module and asymmetric encoder-decoder structure. Embedding module converts continuous gene expression scalars into learnable high-dimensional vectors. Encoder processes only nonzero and nonmasked gene embeddings plus T and S tokens. Decoder combines encoder output with mask and zero embeddings. Final MLP layer projects decoder output to expression values.
methods.name: xTrimoGene architecture
methods.protocol: Scalable transformer-based model with embedding module and asymmetric encoder-decoder structure. Embedding module converts continuous gene expression scalars into learnable high-dimensional vectors. Encoder processes only nonzero and nonmasked gene embeddings plus T and S tokens. Decoder combines encoder output with mask and zero embeddings. Final MLP layer projects decoder output to expression values.

methods.description: For each cell, a hierarchical Bayesian downsampling strategy generates a low total counts variant. Normalize and log-transform both raw and input vectors. Define T (target total counts of raw sample) and S (source total counts of input sample). Randomly mask 30% of both zero and nonzero genes. Model predicts raw expression at masked positions using masked input plus T and S indicators. Loss is regression (MSE) on masked positions.
